$comment: HEALTH_STATISTICS first canary command list. NONE of these has been run. Every mutating step needs its own explicit owner approval; approval for one step never covers the next.
stop_rules: first non-2xx from the canary surface stops the sequence
any platform termination (exceededCpu / exceededResources) stops the sequence, no retry
more than 44 D1 calls, more than 3 source requests, more than 30 observations or a non-transient reader error stops the sequence
never print, persist or commit a token; OPS_TOKEN only through stdin / env
never push or merge from this sequence
a COMPLETED or terminal logical run is never replayed or replaced; a terminal non-completed run needs a new owner decision
D1_PROFILE_STALE=YES after any change to the canary execution path: remeasure before authorization
the post-canary hand-off is owner-triggered only and is never a second canary run; a terminal hand-off run needs a new owner decision
per-invocation limits apply independently to the canary run and to the hand-off (never add the two invocations together)

commands.purpose: read-only account and capacity check (plan stays as the owner states it; never inferred)
commands.command: npx wrangler d1 list && npx wrangler d1 info global-content-os
commands.expected: readable; daily row quotas well below limits

commands.purpose: moved to the infrastructure sequence: create the dedicated production STATS_DB (item 38)
commands.expected: new empty database; database_id recorded in a local-only note until S4
commands.rollback: leave unbound (isolated, empty); deletion only on a separate explicit owner approval

commands.purpose: moved to the infrastructure sequence: apply statistics migration 0001 to the new database only (item 39)
commands.expected: migration ledger shows 0001 only; statistics tables present; content tables absent
commands.rollback: D1 Time Travel bookmark recorded before; database is new, so rollback = leave unbound

commands.purpose: moved to the infrastructure sequence: STATS_DB binding with the canary switch false, deploy the dormant routes (item 40)
commands.expected: /api/ready READY; status route 403/503-safe; content routes unchanged
commands.rollback: redeploy the previous Worker version recorded at preflight (read live, not assumed)

commands.purpose: OPS_TOKEN for the operator CLI: the owner supplies the existing production token through the environment; creating or rotating a token is a separate mutation that this package does not perform
commands.command: export OPS_TOKEN from the owner secret store; if a rotation is wanted: OWNER_APPROVAL_OPS_TOKEN_FOR_STATS_CANARY, token via stdin only to wrangler secret put
commands.expected: status returns STATS_DB bound, schema applied, policy DISABLED, 0 active policies
commands.rollback: delete nothing; rotate again if exposed

commands.purpose: enable the canary master switch (var true) with a reviewed redeploy; the registry is already bootstrapped by owner SQL (infra step I5), so no bootstrap call is needed
commands.expected: switch true; routes answer; 0 policy rows, 0 ACTIVE

commands.purpose: owner-run SQL arming (DISABLED -> ACTIVATION_GATED, never ACTIVE); NOT a Worker route
commands.command: npx wrangler d1 execute global-content-os-stats --remote --file <arm.sql with {{OWNER_REF}} and {{UTC_NOW}} substituted> (file: release/statistics-canary-policy-arm.sql)

commands.purpose: the ONE logical canary run: invocation 1 creates it; invocations 2-3 may only resume that same RUNNING run (cap 3 enforced by the CLI counter)
commands.command: node scripts/statistics-canary-operator.mjs --url <worker> run (with wrangler tail --format json capture)
commands.expected: 27 observation versions, 9 series, 1 release, 1 source request, <= 40 D1 calls target / 44 hard stop (measured 38 on fixtures); STAGED not projected (current_observations stays 0); a COMPLETED or terminal run is refused, never replayed or replaced; first non-2xx or platform termination = STOP, no retry

commands.purpose: read back: counts, rows, tail, analytics
commands.command: operator status + read-only wrangler d1 execute counts + wrangler tail capture + read-only analytics query (CF_API_TOKEN env only)
commands.expected: counts equal the run result; CPU and wall recorded

commands.purpose: owner reviews the S9 evidence, records the PASSED canary and moves ACTIVATION_GATED -> ACTIVE (owner SQL). Starts no ingestion; production projection comes only from the owner-triggered hand-off S9c
commands.command: npx wrangler d1 execute global-content-os-stats --remote --file <activate.sql substituted> (release/statistics-canary-policy-activate.sql)
commands.expected: policy ACTIVE, canary_gate PASSED; no run, no refetch

commands.purpose: POST_CANARY_PRODUCTION_HANDOFF_RUN: owner-triggered, PRODUCTION class, exactly ONE bounded Eurostat request for the same frozen slice (not a second canary run)
commands.command: node scripts/statistics-canary-operator.mjs --url <worker> handoff (with wrangler tail --format json capture)
commands.expected: 27 production observation versions, current_observations 27, <= 40 D1 calls target / 44 hard stop (measured 38 on fixtures), 1 source request; CANARY history unchanged; a COMPLETED or terminal hand-off is refused, never replayed or replaced; first non-2xx or platform termination = STOP, no retry
commands.rollback: owner pause SQL (release/statistics-canary-policy-pause.sql); data is retained

commands.purpose: read back the projection and the identities (read-only): current rows = 27, one per cell, PRODUCTION-only; canary rows unchanged
commands.command: operator status + read-only wrangler d1 execute counts (versions by release class, current_observations by release class, runs by mode)
commands.expected: versions 54 (27 per class), current 27 all from the PRODUCTION release, runs: 1 CANARY + 1 PRODUCTION

commands.purpose: shutdown: owner pause (or disarm) SQL, then redeploy the switch false
commands.command: npx wrangler d1 execute global-content-os-stats --remote --file <pause.sql or disarm.sql> (release/statistics-canary-policy-{pause,disarm}.sql); redeploy with STATISTICS_CANARY_ENABLED=false
commands.expected: policy DISABLED; switch false; GCOS READY
